name: LISC - Season 1
source:
Santa county... symbol of wealth and peace. but what if it really isn't? A young boy, living in a neighborhood where everything seems usual and innocent and then discovers the dark and lustful lifestyles of deamons.Witness all the destruction he will experience and the great change he will make.This city has only one rule. Trust... No one. Trust only yourself
.
[From [url=https://boldbash.itch.io/lisc-life-in-santa-county]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
圣塔县……财富与和平的象征。可如果事实并非如此呢？一个年轻男孩生活在看似平凡而单纯的社区，却意外发现了那些“恶魔”阴暗而充满欲望的生活。见证他将经历的重重摧毁，以及他将带来的巨大改变。这座城市只有一条规则：信任……谁也别信。只相信你自己。

[摘自[url=https://boldbash.itch.io/lisc-life-in-santa-county]Itch.io[/url]]
